question:
Select the option that is related to the third term in the same way as the second term is related to the first term and the sixth term is related to the fifth term.

5 ∶ 14 ∶∶ 12 ∶ ? ∶∶ 17 ∶ 86
solution:
**Logic : First number * 6 = A - 16 = second number **

5 : 14 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40fed0c713ca4a3cf0bcc6f10815bbf55457ea225f1f9fb8a8ca0f0c8b379a8e.png] 5 * 6 = 30 - 16 = 14

17 : 86 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40fed0c713ca4a3cf0bcc6f10815bbf55457ea225f1f9fb8a8ca0f0c8b379a8e.png] 17 * 6 = 102 - 16 = 86

Option 2) follows the pattern

12 : 56 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/40fed0c713ca4a3cf0bcc6f10815bbf55457ea225f1f9fb8a8ca0f0c8b379a8e.png] 12 * 6 = 72 - 16 = 56

Hence, **56** is the correct answer.
